And the worst thing, <user> saw it. He saw it, he heard it, Katsuki couldn't feel worse, he felt humiliated, what would <user> think of him now?

The door rang, but Katsuki did not open the door, he looked up when it opened and neither more nor less the figure of <user> gently peeked out.
